title: INTELSYS Install Studio project (.isproj), schema version 1
description: Declarative description of an installer. This file is the contract between the designer, the isbuild CLI and the packagers: anything the designer can produce must be reproducible from this file alone.

name.description: Shown during install and in Add/Remove Programs.

version.description: major.minor.build. Windows Installer compares only these three fields; a fourth is stored but never affects upgrades.

manufacturer.description: The publisher, as it should appear to a customer's IT department.

upgradeCode.description: Identifies the product family for upgrades. Generate once, then never change it: a new upgrade code makes every future release install alongside the old one instead of replacing it.

description.description: Free text stored in the package's properties.

scope.description: perMachine installs for every user and requires elevation. Per-user installs arrive with their own release.

programFilesSubfolder.description: Folder below Program Files, e.g. INTELSYS\Install Studio. Empty means manufacturer and product name are used.

files.description: Folders of build output to install.

source.description: Folder to take files from, relative to this project file.

target.description: Where the files go: INSTALLFOLDER, optionally with a subpath such as INSTALLFOLDER/plugins.

exclude.description: Patterns to leave out. A pattern without a slash matches file names anywhere (*.pdb); one with a slash matches the path relative to source.

outputFolder.description: Folder for build output, relative to this project file.

packageFileName.description: Name of the package. Empty means name and version are used.

cabinetName.description: Name of the cabinet embedded in the package.
